children: Venice Token's VVV token opens spot trading on OKX's global spot markets on 15 Sep 2026. Venice is a privacy-focused AI platform that offers generative conversation and image creation without retaining any user data. The listing places VVV on one of the largest global crypto venues, giving holders a direct route to buy and sell the token on a major exchange.

A spot listing on a large venue expands liquidity and retail access for VVV. OKX becomes a new price-discovery venue, and its order books can absorb larger trades with tighter spreads than smaller markets. For traders, the listing can drive near-term repositioning as price signals from OKX feed into other venues.

Exchange availability also lowers the barrier for users who want exposure to the token without navigating decentralized venues. Actual liquidity depth on OKX will determine how much the listing reduces slippage in practice.
